candidates.title: Midnight marsh seed-pod chain-of-custody survey
candidates.concept: An adult wetland forensic botanist maps torn seed pods and waterborne fibers across a moonlit boardwalk, aligning numbered specimen jars with a tide-mark grid while a portable macro camera records the transfer pattern.

candidates.title: Moonlit orchid-house pollen trajectory reconstruction
candidates.concept: An adult forensic botanist reconstructs a luminous pollen-transfer path inside a nocturnal orchid conservatory, placing transparent measurement panels between rare blooms while a macro camera and numbered evidence dishes document the trace.

candidates.title: Night arboretum bark-spore timeline reconstruction
candidates.concept: An adult tree-pathology investigator reconstructs a spore-release timeline beside a storm-damaged cedar at night, comparing bark casts, wind ribbons, and timestamped microscope slides under shielded field lamps.

candidates.title: After-dark rooftop greenhouse leaf-residue inquiry
candidates.concept: An adult plant-forensics analyst compares leaf impressions, irrigation droplets, and mineral residue in a rooftop greenhouse after dark, arranging sample cards along a geometric bench map as city lights reflect in wet glass.

selection_rule.description: Sort candidates by candidate_id ascending, then choose the zero-based index seed modulo candidate_count.
